basic_info.description: This 1920's condo enthralls from start to finish with period details like crown molding, wainscoting, arched doorways, and coved ceilings. Discover an open, inviting home, beginning with the bright living room. The kitchen with updated quartz countertops conveniently overlooks the separate dining room, perfect for dinner parties! Dark hardwood floors create a warm atmosphere while built-in storage and shelving throughout provide smart places to showcase personal touches. Two sizable bedrooms (one with views of downtown), a bathroom, and in-unit stackable washer/dryer complete the home. Other details: unit shares no walls with neighbors, has windows on 4 sides, includes 2-bike parking, updated lighting throughout, and is managed by an intimate 5-unit HOA. Wonderful opportunity to live near all of the Mission's trendy shops and eateries. In fact the unit sits above El Buen Comer, a Mexican restaurant featured in the SF Chronicle for top restaurants of San Francisco and in the Michelin Guide! Plus Safeway, Walgreens, and Zip-Cars are all across the street! 97 walk, 74 bike, and 78 public transit scores.
